text:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER — Incident 3580012345: ingress 502/504 spike detected on api-gateway (edge cluster us-west-2). High error rate since 02:14 UTC. Escalation: page. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ingress-502 

jordan: I'm on it :rotating_light: Grafana shows error-rate jump ~02:14. 502s concentrated at edge-proxy layer, backend latencies look normal. initial routing fanout looks suspicious. @liam can you confirm if any edge config pushes happened?

priya: pulling gateway logs now — seeing repeated "upstream response timeout" and some "502 while reading response" entries. Dumping a small sample to thread.

liam: no config pushes from edge team since 01:30 UTC. No infra deploys in that window either. Will check proxy pools and healthcheck states.

casey: customer-impact: ~12% of requests hitting west region returning 502/504s per synthetic monitoring. A couple of customers opened support tickets. CC @melissa for comms.

melissa: started incident status note draft and pinged top-10 customers likely affected. Will post a short status page update in 10m with mitigation steps.

jordan: quick mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic to proxy-b (fallback proxy group), 2) scale gateway pods +2, 3) temporarily disable image-resize fanout to reduce origin chatter. Executing traffic diversion now.

priya: applying traffic-split patch to route ~100% to proxy-b. Command I'm running:
```bash
# route gateway traffic to proxy-b selector
kubectl -n infra patch svc api-gateway -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"proxy-group":"proxy-b"}}}'
# then bump replicas for gateway deployment
kubectl -n infra scale deploy api-gateway --replicas=$(($(kubectl -n infra get deploy api-gateway -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}')+2))
```

ops-bot: ACTION LOG — traffic-split patch detected for svc/api-gateway, autorollback disabled, scale request accepted.

priya: logs after diversion (excerpt):
```
02:16:42 gateway edge-proxy[pod-21]: upstream response timeout to cache-01:8080 (conn 0x7f)
02:16:45 gateway edge-proxy[pod-21]: 502 via upstream error, req_id=abc123
02:17:03 gateway edge-proxy[pod-33]: connection reset by peer while reading response
```

jordan: after diverting traffic + scaling and disabling fanout, error rate dropped from ~18% -> ~3% within 4 minutes. Monitoring closely. :thumbsup:

liam: digging deeper — found recent change to proxy keepalive/timeouts in last week's change that increases connection churn with the cache layer under burst. Opening PR to revert that specific patch. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/edge-proxy/pull/784

deploy-bot: deploy triggered for traffic-split and scale operations — rollout finished for svc/api-gateway to proxy-b. No failed pods in new replicas.

casey: CS update: posted message to affected customers, triage queue flagged premium accounts for priority response.

priya: continuing 15m watch window. Setting a dashboard alert to fire if 5xx rate > 5% for > 3m.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT STATE — mitigated. Current severity: degraded -> mitigated. Please hand off monitoring duty when ready.

jordan: summary / next steps: 1) short-term mitigation successful (traffic diverted to proxy-b + scale). 2) liam to revert keepalive change (PR 784) and validate under staging load. 3) priya to add alert for upstream timeout spike & increase retention for gateway logs for next 24h. 4) melissa/casey continue CS comms. 5) postmortem owners: liam + priya, draft due EOD tomorrow.

jordan: handing off active monitoring to priya at 03:00 UTC for the next 2 hours — sign off here when stable. :white_check_mark: 

priya: acknowledged. I'll keep an eye and escalate back to oncall if we see >5% 5xx again.

melissa: I'll include mitigation notes and ETA for full resolution in the customer update.

liam: starting the revert PR and a loadtest against cache layer to validate. Will share results in this thread.

casey: closing loop for now, marking incident as Mitigated in ops board. Will reopen if symptoms reappear.

pagerduty-bot: Pager cleared for active paging. If error rate rises above threshold, new page will be opened automatically. Thank you everyone. :heart:
